records.geographicEvidence: The official homepage names Destin, Fort Walton Beach and Panama City Beach as the company's service locations; only those named public cities are used.

records.duplicateCheck: Normalized name and affordablegarage.repair were absent from all 14,241 run-start baseline placements; the similarly named Montgomery business uses a different name, domain, location and identity.
